scope: Cardinality source cases and their exhaustive permutations only; other ADR-0014 categories and combined generation 2 acceptance remain pending.

recipe.cardinality: many has inclusive min1/max2 and profile order; required/optional use their accepted counts
recipe.rows: invalid row is last: required0, optional2, many3; identical optional rows are empty; conflicting rows choose distinct compatible providers
recipe.graph: consumer is the sole root; all three providers are selected; repeated group has no edges and makes the reached frontier incomplete, suppressing unproved unreachable conclusions
recipe.expected: one duplicate-record, plus one row-local cardinality only for the invalid recipe; no plan or digest
recipe.enumeration: cardinality, recordCount, rowRecipe in listed order; record permutations by source-index traversal with exact JSON deduplication; within each record permutation, provider permutations form a left-to-right Cartesian product; zero-based six-digit ranks
recipe.streamEncoding: each complete materialized case as RFC8785 UTF-8 followed by LF; SHA-256 over concatenation; no seed or sampling
